# HEM v0.8.2b1

Room overview readings show the value and unit first, followed by the vertically centered metric name. Illuminance reads, for example, **49 lx**.

Room information, warnings and errors follow the condition faces inside the room tab. Turn off **Home settings → Room overview → Show room smileys** to hide faces across all rooms. The setting defaults to on. Alerts and written conditions stay available in either setting.
